title: Lovable 2.0: What Changed and What It Means for Vibe Coding
summary: Lovable 2.0 shipped multiplayer collaboration, a smarter chat agent, and built-in security scanning. Here's exactly what changed — and what still hasn't.
body_markdown: Not for every feature — but the security scan, database queries via the chat agent, and most meaningful backend functionality require a connected Supabase project. If you want persistent data without setting up Supabase yourself,[Blink](https://blink.new/) provisions a database automatically as part of building your app.
